BridgeVerdictInvariant_x.signature: BridgeVerdictInvariant_x(o_i, o_j; epsilon_src, epsilon_obs, B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
BridgeVerdictInvariant_x.definition: All permitted bridge witnesses for the same ordered observation pair produce the same defined distinction-threshold verdict.
BridgeVerdictInvariant_x.nonfunctional_policy: Required unless the bridge mapping is proved functional.

threshold_policy.shared_threshold_exception: A single threshold is permitted only under SharedDistinctionScale_x proving a common ordered codomain and common interpretation.
threshold_policy.required_preservation: D(X|Z) > epsilon_src and d_obs(o_i,o_j) > epsilon_obs preserve the same relevant pass/fail meaning under ThresholdMap_x.

revised_bridge_witness.signature: FCI005DistinctionBridgeWitness_x(w, o_i, o_j; epsilon_src, epsilon_obs, B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
definition: PermittedFCI005BridgeWitness_x(w, o_i, o_j; B_x, D_rel, R).
ThresholdMap_x(epsilon_src, epsilon_obs; D_rel) holds unless a shared scale is proved.
DistinctionThresholdBridge_x(D(w.X|w.Z), d_obs(o_i,o_j), epsilon_src, epsilon_obs; D_rel) = PRESERVED.

binary_evaluator.signature: EvalBCon_FCI005Distinction_x(o_i, o_j; epsilon_src, epsilon_obs, B_x, D_rel, R) : BinaryConstraintResult_x

rules.COMPATIBLE: At least one permitted witness exists, every bridge is defined, BridgeVerdictInvariant_x holds, and the preserved distinction-floor result passes.
rules.INCOMPATIBLE: At least one permitted witness exists, every bridge is defined, BridgeVerdictInvariant_x holds, and the preserved distinction-floor result fails.
rules.UNDEFINED: No permitted witness exists, a required bridge or threshold translation is undefined, or permitted witnesses disagree.
